summary: This informational document lists control-plane requirements for the Split Network Virtualization Edge architecture. In it, NVE functions are divided between a server and external network equipment. It describes what the control software on the server and the external equipment need from each other.

eli5.summary: A job is shared between a worker in the server and a helper box outside. This lists what they must tell each other to cooperate.
